note: Phase 7 closes nothing without a registered mutation falsification. It owns 561 function rows and 502 data objects: 14 functions are closed, 299 reconstructed functions remain unfalsified, 248 functions are not reconstructed in this phase, and no data object is dispositioned. The ledger accounts for every owned row without treating transcript agreement alone as closure.

proof_kinds.differential_falsified: a mutation aimed at this row in a throwaway `git archive` copy, rebuilt, and run against the committed oracle transcript through the registered Phase 7 staged-pair gate named on the row. The mutation is to the row's behavior, and the measured non-zero transcript delta identifies its detection.
proof_kinds.static_proof_falsified: a mutation aimed at the row and caught by a static check rather than a differential. Phase 7 has none.

deferred_reasons.not_reconstructed_in_phase: this phase did not reconstruct this row and names nothing that blocks it. A debt, not an obstruction.
deferred_reasons.reconstructed_not_falsified: the row is reconstructed and carries a recorded proof, but no mutation has been aimed at it. This is the work the phase has left; each row needs one mutation and one measured detection.
deferred_reasons.data_object_not_dispositioned: no closure schema lets any phase close a data object, so the data half arrives here by construction.

entry_points: the census rows this phase owns, by rva

falsification.mutation: the actor-validity guard was inverted in a throwaway `git archive` copy of HEAD: `if(!desc.isValid())` became `if(desc.isValid())`, so every valid descriptor took the failure path and `createActor` returned 0. The copy was rebuilt with NxFoundation, NxPhysics and NxPhysicsJointTests, and the harness was run against the rebuilt pair with the pinned oracle transcript as the baseline. CAUGHT, measured as stdout_delta=27: the mutant exit=1 with a 7-line transcript against the oracle's 29, and the lines it loses are `fixture=a,created b,created` and all four cases' `created=yes`, `out_anchor`, `actors` and `released` lines -- so the mutation is caught by the registered assertion `case=revolute index=0 created=yes` as well as by the diff.

the dynamics guard was inverted in a throwaway `git archive` copy of HEAD: `if(!mark0 && !mark1)` became `if(mark0 && mark1)`, so a pair of actors that ARE dynamic was reported as having none and `createJoint` returned null. The copy was rebuilt with NxFoundation, NxPhysics and NxPhysicsJointTests, and the harness was run against the rebuilt pair with the pinned oracle transcript as the baseline. CAUGHT, measured as stdout_delta=30: the mutant exit=0 with a 21-line transcript against the oracle's 29, and every case loses its `created=yes`, `out_anchor`, `actors` and `released` lines while gaining the row's OWN error text -- "PhysicsSDK::createJoint: at least one of the two actors must be dynamic!". That the failure is reported by the row under test, and that the transcript loses the lines the row produces, is what makes this a falsification of this row rather than of the descriptor rows it drives.

the initialiser was made to refuse every descriptor in a throwaway `git archive` copy of HEAD: `return true;` at the end of `NxSceneInternal::initialise` became `return false;`, so `createScene` destroyed the object it had just built and returned 0. The copy was rebuilt with NxFoundation, NxPhysics and NxPhysicsJointTests, and the harness was run against the rebuilt pair with the pinned oracle transcript as the baseline. CAUGHT, measured as stdout_delta=28: the mutant exit=1 with a 6-line transcript against the oracle's 29, and the lines it loses are `scene=created` and everything after it -- the fixture, all four cases' created/out_anchor/actors/released lines, and both release lines.

the body link was short-circuited in a throwaway `git archive` copy of HEAD: `nxActorBuildBody` returns before linking the body at actor+0x14, so every actor the harness builds is static. `Scene::createJoint` then refuses the pair -- "at least one of the two actors must be dynamic" -- and every case fails to create its joint. The copy was rebuilt with NxFoundation, NxPhysics and NxPhysicsJointTests, and the harness was run against the rebuilt pair with the pinned oracle transcript as the baseline. CAUGHT, measured as stdout_delta=30: the mutant exit=0 with a 21-line transcript against the oracle's 29, losing every case's `created=yes`, `out_anchor`, `actors` and `released` lines.

In a throwaway git-archive copy of committed HEAD, changed the row's Scene+0x544 store from `elapsedTime` to `elapsedTime + 0.125f`, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsSimulationTests, and ran the registered Phase 7 differential against the pinned oracle. The fixture's expected submitted dt `3e000000` became `3e800000`; the mutated candidate still exited 0 but diverged across the simulation transcript.

In a throwaway source mutation, changed the reconstructed contended-write diagnostic source line in NpScene::setShapePairFlags from 0xb8 to 0xb9, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsPairFlagTests, and reran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential. The focused test observes the error line and the unchanged pair-table result.

In a throwaway source mutation, changed the reconstructed contended-write diagnostic source line in NpScene::setActorPairFlags from 0xab to 0xac, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsPairFlagTests, and reran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential. The fixture observes the diagnostic while verifying the pre-existing actor-pair flags remain unchanged.

Changed the NpScene::createActor contention diagnostic line from 0x69 to 0x6a in a source mutation, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsPairFlagTests, then ran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential. The candidate emitted line 0x6a where the oracle emitted 0x69; the focused lock fixture still observed a null actor and an unchanged two-actor scene.

Changed the NpScene::releaseActor contention diagnostic line from 0x70 to 0x71 in a source mutation, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsPairFlagTests, then ran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential. The candidate emitted line 0x71 where the oracle emitted 0x70; the focused lock fixture still observed the actor present.

Changed the NpScene::createJoint contention diagnostic line from 0x78 to 0x79 in a source mutation, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsPairFlagTests, then ran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential. The candidate emitted line 0x79 where the oracle emitted 0x78; the focused lock fixture still observed a null joint and unchanged joint count.

In a throwaway git-archive copy of HEAD 0ac9f256, replaced NxSceneInternal::processSimulationCallbacks' `contactReport->onContactNotify(pair, events)` call with a no-op, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsSimulationTests, and ran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential. Both processes exited 0 and stderr matched exactly; the candidate omitted the buffered actor-contact notifications exercised by the real contact simulation and the paired fetch callback fixture.

In a throwaway git-archive copy of HEAD 1bb2955d, replaced NpScene::fetchResults' `mScene->processSimulationCallbacks()` call with a no-op, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsSimulationTests, and ran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential. The deferred-contact fixture reported the queued record retained but never delivered; its assertion set candidate_exit=1 while oracle_exit=0. The candidate still emitted its staged module identities and stderr matched exactly.

In a throwaway git-archive copy of committed HEAD 34ecced5, changed the coherent public broad-phase selector mapping in nxSceneApplyDescriptorFlags from engine mode 3 to 2, rebuilt NxPhysics and NxPhysicsSimulationTests, then ran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential against the pinned oracle. The oracle reported selector=2 mode=3 while the mutant reported mode=2; both exited 0 and stderr matched exactly.

In a throwaway source mutation of NpScene::NpScene, replaced `mScene = scene` with `mScene = 0`, rebuilt NxPhysics, and ran the registered Phase 7 staged-pair differential against the pinned DLL. The oracle reported `scene constructor internal_link=1`; the mutant reported `internal_link=0`, exited 1, and emitted its staged module identities. After restoring the source byte for byte and rebuilding, oracle and candidate both reported `internal_link=1`, exited 0, and matched exactly.
